provenance: Identity, provenance and lineage: how documents, parties, laws and derived records are identified, versioned and traced to their origins.
W3C PROV-O, GLEIF LEI, European Legislation Identifier (ELI), URN:LEX, W3C Verifiable Credentials
law-markup: How primary law is published as structured, addressable data, including point-in-time versions.
Akoma Ntoso / OASIS LegalDocML, USLM (US Code XML), e-Gov 法令API / 法令XML (Japan), legislation.gov.uk CLML, Delaware Code online
norms-rules: How legal norms (who must / may / must not do what, under what conditions, or else what) are formally represented and evaluated.
Institutional Grammar 2.0 (ADICO), OASIS LegalRuleML, W3C ODRL, Catala, LKIF, Blawx / s(CASP), Symboleo
contract-models: Data models for contracts as structured objects: parties, clauses, parameters, obligations, events and lifecycle.
Accord Project (Concerto, TemplateMark, Cicero), ISDA Common Domain Model, EDM Council FIBO, Symboleo, OASIS eContracts
standard-forms: Market-standard agreements and form libraries for NDAs, services, IP licensing and assignment, startup financing and corporate governance, in the US and Japan.
Common Paper, Bonterms, oneNDA, Y Combinator SAFE, NVCA model documents, Cooley GO forms, JPO / METI model contracts (モデル契約書)
clause-corpora: Clause taxonomies and labelled contract datasets for learning clause families, parameters and variation.
CUAD, LEDGAR, MAUD, ContractNLI, ACORD, SEC EDGAR exhibits, SALI LMSS
ip-licensing: Formal models of intellectual-property rights, licences, grants, fields of use, territories and assignments.
W3C ODRL, SPDX, Creative Commons REL, WIPO ST standards, USPTO assignment data
tooling: Open-source packages and tools for drafting, assembling, comparing, rendering and executing legal documents and rules.
docassemble, Accord Project runtime, Catala compiler, OpenFisca, LexNLP, docx redline libraries, Pandoc
